players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Baltimore downgraded Jackson (high ankle sprain) from questionable to out on Saturday, Oct. 24, for Sunday vs. Cincinnati, his third straight missed game. Tyler Huntley starts again.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 9:44 AM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Mayfield (right thumb) practiced fully all week and is set to start Sunday, Oct. 25, at Carolina after missing three games, per Todd Bowles and NFL.com. He still carries a questionable tag.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: Baker Mayfield is set to start Sunday, Oct. 25, at Carolina, so Daniels goes back to the bench after going 1-2 as the fill-in starter.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (back) as of 12:38 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Beck (back spasms) is questionable for Sunday, Oct. 25, vs. Denver, but he is expected to be inactive again. Jacoby Brissett starts, with Gardner Minshew as the backup.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: McCarthy makes his first start as the Giants' QB1 on Sunday, Oct. 25, at Houston. He replaces the benched Jameis Winston, and Jaxson Dart is out for the season.

players.name: Jameis Winston
players.note: Winston is the Giants' backup for Week 7 at Houston (Oct. 25) after being benched for J.J. McCarthy.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (quadriceps) as of 9:44 AM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Ian Rapoport reported Sun Oct 25 that Hall (quad) is unlikely to play vs. Miami, though he may test it in a pregame workout. He remains officially questionable, so check inactives before kickoff.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: With Breece Hall (quad) reported unlikely to play Sunday (Oct 25, per Rapoport), Allen is set to lead the Jets backfield again vs. Miami, with Isaiah Davis behind him.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring) practiced fully Saturday (Oct 24) after limited sessions earlier in the week. He is still officially questionable for Monday night vs. Dallas but is trending toward returning.

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.note: Saquon Barkley practiced fully Saturday (Oct 24) and is trending toward playing Monday vs. Dallas, which would push Pierce back to a backup role.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.note: The Vikings activated Mason (thumb) from IR on Saturday (Oct 24), and he is expected to play Sunday vs. Indianapolis after full practices all week. Expect a timeshare with Aaron Jones, and possibly the larger share of carries.

players.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 12:38 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Jordan Mason was activated from IR Saturday (Oct 24) and is expected to play Sunday vs. the Colts, so Jones goes from a bell-cow workload back to a split, possibly as the 1B back.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:38 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Denver activated Coleman (high ankle) from IR on Saturday (Oct 24) for Sunday at Arizona. He is expected to play but will likely be the RB3 behind J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey as he is eased back in.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:38 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Washington (foot/back) did not practice Thursday or Friday (Oct 22-23) and is questionable vs. the Rams. If he sits, Ashton Jeanty is in line for nearly all the backfield work. No final inactive report had been found as of Sunday morning.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (knee) as of 8:43 AM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Spears (knee) was limited Friday (Oct 23) after a full Thursday session and is questionable vs. Cleveland. He has played through the tag twice this season, but his role is minor behind Tony Pollard.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (ankle) is out for Sunday vs. Denver (ruled out Oct 23), his second straight missed game.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: With Jeremiyah Love out Sunday vs. Denver (Oct 23), Allgeier starts again, but Bam Knight outplayed him in Week 6 (5.3 vs. 2.1 YPC). Several outlets expect a split leaning toward Knight.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Charbonnet (ACL) was ruled out Oct 23 for Sunday vs. Kansas City. No Saturday activation from reserve was confirmed, so his debut is pushed past Week 7.

players.name: Emanuel Wilson
players.note: With Zach Charbonnet ruled out (Oct 23), Wilson gets another start Sunday night vs. Kansas City.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) is out for Sunday vs. the Giants. Houston has a Week 8 bye, so Week 9 is his likely return.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (leg) as of 12:38 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: With David Montgomery (groin) out, Marks leads Houston's backfield again Sunday vs. the Giants (Oct 25).

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) was ruled out Oct 23 for Sunday vs. San Francisco.

players.name: Bijan Robinson
players.note: With Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) out Sunday vs. San Francisco, Bijan should handle a heavy workload, with Khalil Herbert as the expected backup.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Judkins (ankle) is off the final injury report and returns to his lead role Sunday at Tennessee after missing one game. Dylan Sampson, now off IR, should take the passing downs.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: He was ruled out of Week 7 at Carolina (concussion, foot) on the final Oct 23 injury report and remains in the concussion protocol. His Week 8 status is uncertain.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: He is out for Week 7 at Atlanta (hamstring) per the final injury report. He is aiming to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Sleeper moved him from questionable to out (hamstring) on Oct 24, so he will miss Sunday's Week 7 game against Dallas.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: He is on IR with a ruptured hamstring (semitendinosus) and is out for Week 7. Sean McVay said he will miss 6-10 weeks.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: He has been out since Oct 18 with an AC joint shoulder injury. Buffalo's Week 7 bye gives him extra time to heal.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: He remains on IR (heel). Shane Steichen said Oct 19 that his practice window will not open in Week 7.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: He is still listed questionable (quadriceps) for Week 7, and no update was found as of the morning of Oct 25. He has not played since Week 2, so check inactives before lineups lock.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: Terry McLaurin is out for the season with a torn patellar tendon (confirmed Oct 20). Williams moves into a bigger role next to Stefon Diggs starting in Week 7.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: He is Pittsburgh's WR2 with Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR, coming off an 11-catch Week 6. He plays the Saints in Paris on the morning of Oct 25.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: With Romeo Doubs and Mack Hollins on IR, Douglas is a top target next to A.J. Brown. New England already played its Week 7 game, a 30-24 loss at Chicago on Oct 22.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: He practiced fully on Oct 21 (hamstring) and is not on the injury report. He is set to return as a starter in Week 7 against the Colts on Oct 25.

players.name: Jaylin Noel
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (toe) as of 1:40 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: DeMeco Ryans said Tank Dell will make his 2026 debut on Sunday, Oct 25, against the Giants. Along with the Oct 12 trade for Marvin Harrison Jr., that crowds Noel out of targets.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: He saw five targets in his Oct 18 return from IR and is pushing for the WR2 role. Rashod Bateman (shoulder) was expected to be OK for Week 7 against Cincinnati on Oct 25, which caps Lane's upside.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: He came off the injury report (finger) on Oct 23 and should return against Miami on Oct 25 after missing four straight games.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: He came off the injury report (ankle) on Oct 23 and is in line to return against the Jets on Oct 25. He has not played since Week 2.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:38 PM PT Oct 25. Earlier: Nacua (calf) remains questionable and a game-time decision for the 4:25 PM ET game at Las Vegas on Oct 25, after he missed Friday's practice. McVay called it minor, and Sunday-morning reports lean toward him playing, but the Rams had not announced a final call yet.

players.name: Konata Mumpfield
players.note: Davante Adams is out 6-10 weeks (hamstring), and Puka Nacua (calf) is a late game-time decision for Sunday, Oct 25 at Las Vegas. That leaves Mumpfield as a top Rams WR option, with his ceiling rising sharply if Nacua sits.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Houston officially activated Dell from reserve/PUP on Saturday, Oct 24, and he is set for his first game since his 2024 knee injury, Sunday vs. the Giants. Expect a limited snap count at first.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: The Ravens ruled Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) out on Saturday, Oct 24, so Tyler Huntley makes his third straight start Sunday vs. Cincinnati. Jackson's next chance to play is Week 8 vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) is out for Sunday, Oct 25 vs. Carolina, and Baker Mayfield (thumb) is good to go. Hurst is projected for about 80% of snaps and a bigger target share.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for the Eagles' Week 7 Monday night game vs. Dallas (Oct 26). That moves Lemon, who caught 3 of 6 targets in Week 6, into a larger role.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (ribs/Achilles) is out for Sunday at Atlanta, and the 49ers activated Christian Kirk from IR on Saturday, Oct 24 to fill in. With a Week 8 bye, Week 9 is the earliest Evans can return.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring) is out for Sunday night at Seattle, his second straight missed game. KC elevated Justin Watson on Oct 24, and Week 8 vs. Denver is the earliest Rice can return.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon in the Oct 19 MNF game and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: McLaurin's season-ending patellar tendon tear (Oct 19) makes Diggs Washington's clear top WR for the rest of 2026.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey is still in the concussion protocol after the Oct 18 game. The Chargers are on bye in Week 7, and Week 8 is the target for his return.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Harris (hamstring) missed the Oct 18 game, and the Chargers are on bye in Week 7. Week 8 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden led Chicago with 4 catches for 130 yards and a TD in the Oct 22 TNF win over New England. It was his second straight game outproducing Rome Odunze.

players.name: Rome Odunze
players.note: Odunze caught 4 of 5 targets for 69 yards in the Oct 22 TNF win, and Luther Burden outproduced him for the second straight week. His target share is a growing concern.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (hamstring) remains on IR, and New Orleans played Week 7 in Paris without him. Reports point to a Week 9 return after the Saints' Week 8 bye.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Goedert (knee) practiced fully Saturday, Oct 24 after missing Thursday and Friday, and was removed from the injury report. He is expected to play Monday night vs. Dallas, while DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is out, which could mean more targets for him.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: Warren (groin) was ruled out Friday, Oct 23 for Sunday's game at Minnesota, his second straight missed game. Mo Alie-Cox and Will Mallory will handle the tight end snaps.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: Ben Johnson confirmed Oct 23 that Cole Kmet's knee injury is season-ending and he is going to IR. That leaves Loveland as Chicago's clear TE1 starting in Week 7.

players.name: George Kittle
players.note: Mike Evans was ruled out on the 49ers' final Week 7 report (Oct 23), and Ricky Pearsall is on IR, so more targets should go to Kittle Sunday at Atlanta. Kittle has no injury designation.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (concussion) practiced fully this week and came off the injury report Oct 23, so he is in line to return Sunday, Oct 25 vs. Indianapolis after missing time following his Week 5 concussion.

players.name: Bucky Irving
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 10:42 AM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Irving (illness) returned to practice as a limited participant Thursday (Oct 22) after sitting Wednesday, and his availability for Week 7 at Carolina does not appear to be in danger.
